pages.title: A Green Plan for Europe
pages.content:
The European Union (EU) is a group of countries in Europe. The European Commission works for the EU. On 11 December 2019, it showed a new plan to the world. The name of the plan is the Green Deal.

Today, cars and factories send bad gases into the air. These gases make our world hot. The Green Deal wants a clean world. The EU wants net zero in 2050. Gas goes into the air. Then the same gas comes out of the air.

The plan also says, "Use less, and throw away less." People can use old things again.

vocabulary.definition: What you want to do and how.
A building where people make things.
It is all around us; we need it.
Something like air; we cannot see it.
Same gas in and out of the air.

pages.title: Three Big Goals
pages.content:
The Green Deal has three big goals.

Goal 1 is about the climate. Our world is getting hotter. This is a big problem for all countries. The EU wants 55% less bad gas in 2030. It wants net zero in 2050.

Goal 2 is about nature. Water and trees are very important. We should not cut too many trees. We should not use too much water. Plants and animals need a safe home. All people need clean water, clean air and good food.

Goal 3 is about work and money. The EU wants new green companies. Then people can have jobs, and nature can stay safe.

vocabulary.definition: Something you want to do in the future.
The usual weather in a place.
Trees, flowers, animals, rivers and mountains.
A business, like a shop or factory.

pages.title: Why Do We Need It?
pages.content:
Why is the Green Deal important? Our world is in danger. There is a lot of pollution in the air and in the water. The weather is changing, too.

For many years, people used oil, gas and coal for energy. Cars, homes and factories use them every day. But they make bad gases, and they are bad for nature. And one day, there will be no more oil, gas and coal. We cannot use them like this for a long time.

Energy is a big problem today, too. There are wars in some places. Some things from other countries cannot come on time. Then energy is very expensive.

vocabulary.definition: Something that can hurt you.
Dirty air, water or land.
A black thing from under the ground.
A black stone; people burn it.
Power for lights, machines and cars.
Fighting between countries.

pages.title: Energy from the Wind and the Sun
pages.content:
Now many countries use energy from the wind and the sun. This energy never ends, and it is often cheaper. With it, countries do not need expensive oil and gas.

Factories need a lot of energy. They need clean energy at a good price. The EU wants this change to be fast. Countries need a big plan. They also need a lot of money for new clean machines.

vocabulary.definition: Air that moves fast outside.
How much money something is.
We pay for things with it.

pages.title: New Machines for Clean Energy
pages.content:
In 20 or 30 years, the world can be net zero. Then there will be new jobs, new machines and new kinds of energy. Some countries start early and work fast. They can be the best in the world at clean energy.

The EU has a law for this. Its name is the Net-Zero Industry Act. With this law, factories in Europe can make batteries, solar panels and big wind machines. They can also make machines that take bad gas out of the air.

vocabulary.definition: A thing that does work for us.
A rule of a country.
It gives energy to phones and cars.
It makes energy from the sun.

pages.title: Repair and Reuse
pages.content:
The EU has new rules for green things, too. Here are two examples.

Rule 1: Big companies in the EU mustn't throw away new clothes. Sometimes people do not buy some clothes, but the companies mustn't throw them away. That is waste.

Rule 2: It is easy to find parts for machines. Then people can repair their old things and use them again.

Soon, there will be rules like these for a lot of things.

vocabulary.definition: It tells you what you must do.
Using something badly; throwing good things away.
One piece of a bigger thing.
Make a broken thing good again.

pages.title: Smart Shopping and Green Jobs
pages.content:
Shoppers are important, too. Before they buy something, they need good information. Look at a new TV. It has an energy label. The label tells you about the TV's energy. Then you can choose the green one.

Jobs are changing, too. There are more green jobs every year. People need new skills for these jobs. Countries need training for these people.

vocabulary.definition: Facts about something.
It shows how much energy a machine uses.
Something you can do well.
Learning how to do a job.

pages.title: Learning and Working Together
pages.content:
Education is a big part of the Green Deal. All people can learn green skills and computer skills. Then we can all help our world.

Countries, companies and people can all help. Climate change is a problem for every country. Countries should work together.

Türkiye has a Green Deal plan, too. Türkiye made it in 2021. Türkiye wants net zero in 2053.

vocabulary.definition: Teaching and learning, at school and at work.
With other people.
